anchor_and_alias: C00 owns same original bounded selected roots1..5 and per-root/source component depth<=64; every intermediate descriptor and interpreter/entry occurrence requires existing original FD/retained/CPU/wall/share reservation before acquisition. New private object is custody, not resource. Parent exact198 alias adds one real descriptor occurrence and duplicate/flag/close operations to the existing complete plan; all original endpoints/group slots remain independently counted. Occupied198 may also return a higher duplicate requiring cleanup; reserve that failure path too. No original cap is increased. Distinct199 carrier final alias adds another retained occurrence; RW/RO and RO/alias transient overlap must fit original complete FD/resource plan. No existing budget is increased.
clock_and_observation: Original actual S is captured once after prestart prefix before carrier/Popen; R=S+D,G=R-Q,J=min(S+I,G),E same H. Every added operation consumes original windows. Pure reservation used+outstanding never substitutes for actual measured child CPU/cumulative physical observations; no zero-fill/refund/clock reset.

envelope_formula.canonical: exact selected strict canonical UTF8 JSON encoder, compact sorted-key serialization, original scalar/noNUL/finite/integer bounds. No repr or arbitrary serializer callback.
envelope_formula.delivery_bytes: Use exact canonical embedded object byte lengths, without standalone LF for grant/Pin children: len(canonical_json_no_LF(grant))+len(canonical_json_no_LF(pin))+exact fixed envelope punctuation/key/schema overhead. Add actual PacketV1 framing and its own single finalLF. Source computes full exact bound before grant and rechecks actual complete bytes. No double-LF approximation.
envelope_formula.no_self_reference: Grant body contains no own Pin/envelope. Envelope references only completed original grant; EffectObservation names that same earlier delivered Pin. No additional H publication of envelope is required; actual send/receive bytes and evidence remain original transport custody.
envelope_formula.preflight: Before grant publication and before effect, source knows original context/sequence, fixed host path, bounded ledger-slot/issued/cost field widths and actual intent. Reserve the entire upper-bound encoded grant, readback, later envelope+outer packet, sender/receiver/canonical/parse/verification copies and work. Capacity placeholders are scalar size bounds only, not Pins/captures/authority. After actual capture, recheck full exact encoding under the same reserved ceiling before send. If it does not fit, retain existing prefix and refuse without effect or retry.
envelope_formula.schema_maxima_vs_actual: The unrestricted full schema maximum may exceed65536 (e.g.64 prior Pins). That does not authorize fragmentation of a reply or larger packets. Each actual intent/grant/envelope must fit full packet bounds; otherwise refuse. Existing publication chunking is only for its explicitly selected publication route.

each actual completed earlier selection plus all FDs; future selection absent, C01H refused
same anchor, completed selections and any earlier handle; no double-close or equal-record factory
actual held original slot/debits and completed prefix; no delivery or effect without complete capture
actual H capture after write/readback even on lost reply, worker uncertainty and poisoning; no replay/refund
source actual returned prefixes plus unknown dimensions; diagnostic failure never replaces raw first or makes zero usage
actual step/input/attempt and any render prefix; no fabricated rendered record or request
actual first capture if second fails, both original attempted slots, poison/terminal ordinal; no HTTP or retry
original endpoints/group plus every actual alias/Popen/pipe return, independent once-only cleanup, unknown child-local error not parent-observed
actual earlier issuer/owner before publisher, no guessed source
actual qualifier and raw first/capture prefix, no empty default or dependent policy
actual earlier prefix/S if observed, no secondS or spawn after failure
every actual RW/RO/alias write/read/seal prefix and unknown/once-close
actual inherited capability/rawprefix/closed state; no Hello on missing/unknown admission
all actual raw reads/captures/identities/reservations; no Ack without full success

generation_formula.bytes: For each b reserve complete worker encode/retained original input+prompt+canonical copies, every bounded packet buffer/hex copy/send/receive, H reconstruction/parse/canonical validation, original Store write b and actual readback request bound including its existing EOF headroom, returned bytes, acknowledgement and retained raw/pending/observations. Sum actual repeated operation occurrences; do not multiply only successful generations.
generation_formula.files: Two new explicit host publication slots per original generation; count against existing whole owner canonical_publications/maximum_members and profile.maximum_files, including failed slots. Complete source plan must include raw/parsed/later output and all control evidence, not merely these two.
generation_formula.publication_sequences: For actual canonical size b and chosen positive source chunk c<=16384 with full hex/framing packet<=packet_limit, one publication consumes2+ceil(b/c) request/reply slots (begin, each chunk, commit). C18R consumes that quantity for each of the two actual records, plus original render/check/effect/observation traffic. All share the original4096 and preselected smaller count; no reset.
generation_formula.source_limits: PromptText/sample/context and original selected LocalBackendProfile limits remain unchanged. Exact actual UTF8, request, prompt, maximum_generated_tokens and fixed sampling checks precede publication/HTTP. An infeasible full schedule refuses; it does not reduce mandatory jobs.
generation_formula.source_rule: Exactly one rendered-template capture and one CompletionRequest capture per actually entered fresh original generation; both were required semantic products, now assigned closed source paths. Any failed entered slot remains counted. No extra generation or replicate.

intersection: Every operation intersects all original actual profile request/metadata/member/file/depth/retained/read/write/work/process/CPU/wall budgets and exact original stage deadline. Structural ceilings do not grant capacity. The full original campaign must preflight or refuse; no truncation/new funding.
method: This is a finite source/design capacity derivation and required preflight, not measured scientific feasibility or proof of actual runtime memory/syscall/CPU/FD behavior.

v3_required_schedules.canonical_source: Earlier original source-role selection/authentication/accessor must fit original root/source plan; no source publication cycle.
v3_required_schedules.carrier: PREHELLO_BOOTSTRAP_V3 original initial prepaid fixed whole schedule: canonical buffers; write/readback and positive EOF; seals/fstat/readonly reopen/dup/close; kernel/clock/namespace validation; Hello/reply. All actual transient and inherited descriptor occurrences counted within unchanged caps.
v3_required_schedules.live_launch: LAUNCH_GROUP_AND_CLOCK_V3 exact full four-pass hierarchy/raw membership, six raw reads per TID/leader, repeated start checks, full typed capture/readback and current start/group/Ack records. No cardinality-only encoding or omitted failed/raw files.
v3_required_schedules.qualified_tools: QUALIFIED_TOOL_COMMANDS_V3 exact complete distinct tool roster table/capture/readback/qualification/environment lookup and every repeated caller reread. Current full typed metadata may exceed original per-file limit; refusal, no covert chunking/cap raise.
v3_required_schedules.renderer: RENDER_EFFECT_V3 full source-specific bounded operation plus independently reserved two publication schedules; absent actual bound/enforcer refuses.
v3_required_schedules.reservation_vs_observation: Fixed original ledger retains used conservative allocations and unresolved tokens; actual physical cumulative CPU/read/write observations retain their original counters/monotonicity. No generic seven-dimensional charge/refund that feeds reservationCPU into observe_child_cpu. Missing fixed source implementation remains qualification/source prerequisite.
